extracted.intended_audience: readers of the Philosophical Transactions (natural philosophers, experimentalists, anatomists, geologists, metallurgists)
extracted.subtask_description: Writing and reporting empirical natural-history, anatomical, geological, and experimental observations for publication (detailed descriptions of specimens, apparatus, measurements, and interpretations). Emphasizes microscopy, descriptive anatomy, measurement, and cautious inference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific gravity measurements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Specific Gravities of various Bodies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide measured specific gravity values for a wide range of materials (explicit table of substances and numeric specific gravities). The page lists many materials (pump-water, cork, woods, jewels, metals, coins, stones) with their reported specific gravities — include material identification and numerical values in tabular form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Detailed apparatus and furnace description
rubrics_metrics.description: The furnace is built on the side of a hill, the bottom about 2 yards square... lined within with a wall of the best fire-stone; the bellows, which are very large, and played with water, enter about the middle of the focus...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe apparatus dimensions, construction materials, orientation, and operation (e.g., furnace dimensions, lining, bellows type and placement, top-hole size, means to monitor subsidence such as a pole). Include how fuel is added, where and how ore and fuel are placed, and procedural markers used by practitioners (e.g., sinking measure to know when to refill).

rubrics_metrics.name: Report process parameters and timings
rubrics_metrics.description: the blast, which is continued for about 12 hours feeding it still with new charcoal as it settles... they pull out a stopple at the bottom of the wall, whence runs out all the glassy-cinder...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record process durations (heating/blast times), operational steps (when and how to add fuel/ore), intermediate operations (removing cinder via a stopple), and any monitoring practices. Include numeric timings (e.g., 12 hours) and actions tied to those timings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report yields and material balances
rubrics_metrics.description: They get about a hundred weight of metal at one melting, which is the product of about three times as much ore.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report input-output quantities and ratios (ore input to metal output, basket counts, weights). State typical batch yields and any noted variability or process-specific notes (e.g., no limestone used here).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specify provenance and sampling/locality information
rubrics_metrics.description: The ore is got in Fourness, at least 15 miles from Milthorp... Rutupium or Richborough... the Giant's Causeway is in the county of Antrim, about 7 miles east of Colrain and 31 miles east of the mouth of the river Derry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide precise locations (place names, distances, geographic relations) for samples, sites, and observations. This includes archaeological/topographic sites, ore sources, and specimen localities to allow context and replication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use microscopy and give scaled morphological descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: In the seed of an ash, represented of the natural size by fig. 1... the two leaves of the seed or lobes were filled up with an innumerable quantity of very small globules... the fibres were composed of much smaller globules...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report microstructure observed (globules, vessels, fibres), indicate scale or note 'natural size' for figures, and describe internal organization in detail. Include how the microscope enabled observations and reference figures/plates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide temporal development and experimental timing data
rubrics_metrics.description: When they had lain in the wet sand 36 hours, they showed... in 72 hours the roots began to divide and ramify... some seeds sprang up in three days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include time-course observations for growth/development experiments (exact hours/days to germination, sequence of morphological changes). Record environmental conditions (wet sand, closet) alongside timings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make cautious inference and state uncertainty
rubrics_metrics.description: I will affirm nothing herein, till I shall be so lucky as to find an animalcule large enough to discover this truth... Mr. Leuwenhoeck appears to have had very imperfect and indeed erroneous views...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Qualify claims, acknowledge limits of observation and alternative explanations, and refrain from overstatement when evidence is insufficient. Explicitly note conjectures and label them as such.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comparative and analogical reasoning across organisms
rubrics_metrics.description: nature proceeds nearly after the same method in her operations, as to the production of plants and animals... the egg in animals seems to be for the same use as the lobes of the seed in plants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare structures and developmental processes across taxa to suggest general principles, while indicating the basis for analogy (observed similarities) and noting where analogy may break down.

rubrics_metrics.name: Link structure to function with observational support
rubrics_metrics.description: This passage in fowls is exactly in the middle of the palate... hence probably proceeds the quickness of hearing and vigilancy of fowl... pillars in churches very much prevented echoes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When proposing functional interpretations (e.g., auditory anatomy enabling keen hearing), cite the observed morphological features and experimental/observational evidence that supports the functional claim (e.g., communication of air between ears, presence of pillars/laminae).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use experimental manipulations as evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: it did not only appear by pouring into one ear freed from its drum, the other also being removed, a tincture of cochineal, and then blowing it into all these cells... but it appeared also to the naked eye...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include descriptions of manipulative demonstrations (dye injections, sowing trials, breaking specimens) used to reveal anatomy or processes. Explain procedure and observed outcomes clearly so others can replicate the demonstration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide precise dimensional descriptions for geological/architectural features
rubrics_metrics.description: a raised causeway of about 80 feet broad, and about 20 feet high above the rest of the strand... pillars of perpendicular cylinders, hexagons and pentagons, of 18 or 20 inches diameter
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Give measurements (length, breadth, height, diameters), shapes (polygonal cross-sections), extent (how far into the sea), and textural observations (how pillars break). Such precise dimensional description supports geological interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record anatomical variation across species and note functional correlations
rubrics_metrics.description: In the heads of all the fowls that I had an opportunity to examine, I constantly found only one aqueduct... In singing birds, the structure of these passages is like that of the parrot... In the heads of woodcocks... I found one on each side the bone which makes the orbit of the eye...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document interspecific differences in anatomy (number/location of ducts, nerves, cartilaginous sclerotis, presence/absence of structures) and, where possible, relate these differences to behavioral or ecological traits (e.g., vigilance, feeding methods, song).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference prior authorities and acknowledge differing accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: For a more satisfactory description... the reader is referred to the Rev. Dr. Hamilton's Letters... Molyneux asserts that there is not one to be met with... referred to Du Verney's book of the ear.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite relevant prior publications and note disagreements or corrections to earlier accounts. Use references to situate observations in the existing literature and to point readers toward fuller treatments or alternative perspectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Note practical observations and applications
rubrics_metrics.description: They often use the soft ore, with good success, as a medicine for the murrain in cattle, and for all diseases in swine, giving these a good handful or two in milk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record any observed practical uses or applications of materials and practices (e.g., medicinal uses of ores, propagation methods of willows). Distinguish anecdotal/practical notes from experimental results.
